messages:
maria_finance: Heads up — daily usage aggregation job skipped the midnight batch for a subset of accounts (00:00-01:00 window). Seeing gaps in billing reports and downstream invoice drafts.

sam_eng: any errors in the worker logs? which job name?

maria_finance: job: usage-agg-worker-prod. Alert from monitoring: "agg_window_count==0 for shard 7". Saw a spike in missing windows around the deploy.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release 2026.03.22.03 rolled: rolling restarts started for svc-usage-agg (03:59 UTC).

sam_eng: digging in — can you paste the minimal error snippet?

maria_finance: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-22T00:01:12Z] ERROR usa-agg: shard=7 USRAGG-EMPTY-BATCH skipping window start=2026-03-22T00:00
[2026-03-22T00:01:13Z] INFO usa-agg: shard=8 processed=1200 events
[2026-03-22T00:02:01Z] WARN lock: lost-local-lock shard=7 during restart
```

joe_billing: This will underbill customers on tiered usage plans — when the window is missing we fallback to default per-unit pricing. Need manual reprocess for affected accounts.

katie_revops: How many accounts are impacted? any committed customers? we need a list before approving manual runs and comms.

maria_finance: quick query result (non-exhaustive): acct_112, acct_209, acct_314, plus 9 smaller accounts. 12 total, 3 are monthly-commit > $10k. Query used: `SELECT account_id FROM usage_windows WHERE processed=false AND window_start='2026-03-22T00:00'`

sam_eng: root cause hypothesis: the job used node-local lockfiles in /tmp (e.g. /tmp/usage_lock.shard_7). During the rolling restart the lock disappeared and the worker treated the shard as empty instead of retrying. Proposed fix: switch to Redis-based distributed locks + idempotent re-run logic + a safety alert when expected_event_count>0 but processed_count==0.

maria_finance: temporary mitigation: can we run the reprocess tool for the missing windows for those 12 accounts? I can run for the 2 largest first but need ops approval for ad-hoc runs.

deploy-bot: ops: scheduled maintenance window currently not in effect. No blocking.

joe_billing: Approve manual reprocess for the 12 accounts. Please ensure we create audit entries and a dry-run first for verification, then final run. If any invoice delta > $100, flag for comms.

maria_finance: running dry-run for acct_112 and acct_209 now: `./tools/reprocess_usage --acct acct_112 --from 2026-03-22T00:00 --to 2026-03-22T01:00 --dry-run=true`

maria_finance: dry-run output: processed_events=612, expected_events=612, estimated_delta=+$1842.00 (no invoices created in dry-run).

sam_eng: perfect — once dry-run matches expected counts, go ahead with final run. I'll open a quick PR for the Redis lock patch and add the extra alert rule. ETA ~2h.

maria_finance: final run for acct_112 done: `./tools/reprocess_usage --acct acct_112 --from 2026-03-22T00:00 --to 2026-03-22T01:00 --dry-run=false`

maria_finance: final run output: processed 612 events, billed_tokens +$1,842.00, invoice draft created: inv_20260322_112. Audit note attached.

katie_revops: thanks. please compile the final impacted-account list + invoice deltas and post to #billing with suggested customer messaging for >$100 deltas. Legal wants to review any outbound comms for the three enterprise customers.

sam_eng: follow-ups: 1) patch usage-agg-worker to use Redis locks (PR opened) 2) add monitoring that alerts when expected_event_count>0 and processed_count==0 3) backfill runner to scan last 7 days for similar gaps 4) add idempotent window re-run endpoint.

maria_finance: will update here after finishing reprocess for the remaining 11 accounts. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
